name: VO2 hill 4x4 moderate 48
description: Four 4 min climbs at 9.5 km/h, level 5 (about 7 percent): VO2max work on the grade with less impact. Needs --running-mode, handrail up. See docs/treadmill/VO2MAX.md.

ramp.name: Warm-up
ramp.notes: Easy jog, building gently. Last minutes just under the first rep pace.

steps.name: Climb 4 min
steps.notes: RPE 8-9: hard but controlled; the last rep matches the first.

steps.name: Recover
steps.notes: Easy jog or walk; let the breathing drop.

ramp.name: Cooldown
ramp.notes: Jog then walk until the breathing is calm.
